column.name: code
column.description: The opaque single-use authorization code handed to the MCP client.

column.name: client_identifier
column.description: Identifier of the OAuth client the code was issued to.

column.name: customer_reference
column.description: Reference of the customer who completed the browser login.

column.name: id_customer
column.description: Numeric identifier of the customer who completed the browser login.

column.name: code_challenge
column.description: The PKCE code challenge supplied by the client.

column.name: code_challenge_method
column.description: The PKCE code challenge method. Only S256 is accepted.

column.name: redirect_uri
column.description: The redirect URI the code was issued for.

column.name: scopes
column.description: Space separated list of granted scopes.

column.name: expires_at
column.description: The point in time after which the code can no longer be redeemed.

column.name: is_used
column.description: Single-use flag, set when the code has been redeemed.

column.name: identifier
column.description: The opaque MCP access token identifier presented as a bearer token.

column.name: client_identifier
column.description: Identifier of the OAuth client the token was issued to.

column.name: customer_reference
column.description: Reference of the customer the token resolves to.

column.name: id_customer
column.description: Numeric identifier of the customer the token resolves to.

column.name: scopes
column.description: Space separated list of granted scopes.

column.name: expires_at
column.description: The point in time after which the token is no longer valid.

column.name: is_revoked
column.description: Flag indicating the token has been individually revoked.
